tagline: One change to the world, followed all the way. Every scenario episode and Short from the channel, in one place.

guides.title: How The Machine Works
guides.body: Each episode takes one change to the world and follows it honestly: the first minutes, the first day, and what life looks like after it settles. The Videos are the full scenarios. The Shorts are single moments pulled from those same scenarios, so anything that grabs you in a Short has a full episode waiting behind it.

guides.title: Start With The Big Ones
guides.body: New here? Start with What If the Sun Went Out? and What If the Ocean Drained Overnight?, the two scenarios the channel keeps coming back to. Their Shorts are in this list too, marked as Shorts, if you want the one minute version first.

guides.title: How To Use This App
guides.body: Every video on the channel is listed here, newest first. Search by a word in the title. Tap any video to watch it on YouTube, and tap the star to save a favorite. The list refreshes itself from the channel feed when you open the app, so new videos appear here with no app update.
